fullPassage: From the earliest times, healthcare services have been recognized to have two equal aspects, namely clinical care and public healthcare. In classical Greek mythology, the god of medicine, Asklepios, had two daughters, Hygiea and Panacea. The former was the goddess of preventive health and wellness, or hygiene, and the latter the goddess of treatment and curing. In modern times, the societal ascendancy of medical professionalism has caused treatment of sick patients to overshadow those preventive healthcare services provided by the less heroic figures of sanitary engineers, biologists, and governmental public health officers. Nevertheless, the quality of health that human populations enjoy is attributable less to surgical dexterity, innovative pharmaceutical products, and bioengineered devices than to the availability of public sanitation, sewage management, and services which control the pollution of the air, drinking water, urban noise, and food for human consumption. The human right to the highest attainable standard of health depends on public healthcare services no less than on the skills and equipment of doctors and hospitals.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)와 (B)의 treatment의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 의사가 환자를 항생제로 '치료'하도록 권고했다 / (B) 정부가 폐수 '처리'에 수백만을 지출했다
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 처리 — (B) 치료 (의미 뒤바뀜)
✅ ② (A) 치료 — (B) 처리 ←정답
❌ ③ (A) 대우 — (B) 처리 (A는 의료 맥락에서 '치료')
❌ ④ (A) 치료 — (B) 대우 (B는 wastewater와 함께 '처리')
det.tip: treatment: (의료) 치료 vs (폐수/물질) 처리. 본문의 treatment of sick patients = 환자 치료, sewage management = 하수 처리와 연결

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어는?

"the state of being dominant or having power and influence over others"

det.korean: 타인에 대해 지배적이거나 권력과 영향력을 가진 상태 → ascendancy
det.analysis:
❌ ① dexterity — 능숙함, 솜씨 (기술적 역량)
❌ ② consumption — 소비 (사용/섭취)
❌ ③ sanitation — 공중 위생 (위생 시설)
✅ ④ ascendancy — 우위, 지배력 ←정답
det.tip: ascendancy = 우위, 지배력. the societal ascendancy of medical professionalism = 의료 전문성의 사회적 우위

questions.passage: Nevertheless, the quality of health that human populations enjoy is __________ (attribute) less to surgical dexterity, innovative pharmaceutical products, and bioengineered devices than to the availability of public sanitation, sewage management, and services which control the pollution of the air, drinking water, urban noise, and food for human consumption.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 건강의 질은 외과적 능숙함보다 공중 위생에 더 '기인하는' → 형용사 attributable
det.analysis: is __________ less to A than to B → be attributable to 구문. attribute(동사/명사) → attributable(형용사)로 변환. is + 형용사 보어 자리.
det.tip: attribute(귀속시키다, 동사) → attributable(~에 기인하는, 형용사). be attributable to = ~에 기인하다

questions.passage: In modern times, the societal ascendancy of medical __________ (profession) has caused treatment of sick patients to overshadow those preventive healthcare services provided by the less heroic figures of sanitary engineers, biologists, and governmental public health officers.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 의료 '전문성'의 사회적 우위 → 명사 professionalism
det.analysis: medical __________ → 명사 자리. profession(직업) → professionalism(전문성, 직업 의식)으로 변환. 관사 없이 추상 명사로 사용.
det.tip: profession(직업) → professional(전문적인, 형용사/전문가, 명사) → professionalism(전문성, 명사)

questions.passage: From the earliest times, healthcare services have been recognized to have two equal aspects, namely clinical care and public healthcare. In classical Greek mythology, the god of medicine, Asklepios, had two daughters, Hygiea and Panacea. The former was the goddess of preventive health and wellness, or hygiene, and the latter the goddess of treatment and curing. In modern times, the societal ascendancy of medical professionalism has caused treatment of sick patients to overshadow those preventive healthcare services provided by the less heroic figures of sanitary engineers, biologists, and governmental public health officers. Nevertheless, the quality of health that human populations enjoy is attributable less to surgical dexterity, innovative pharmaceutical products, and bioengineered devices than to the availability of public sanitation, sewage management, and services which control the pollution of the air, drinking water, urban noise, and food for human consumption. The human right to __________ depends on public healthcare services no less than on the skills and equipment of doctors and hospitals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 인간의 권리는 달성 가능한 '최고 수준의 건강'에 대한 것이며, 이는 공중 보건 서비스에 못지않게 의존한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① the societal ascendancy of medical care — 의료의 사회적 우위 (앞 문단 내용, 권리의 대상 아님)
✅ ② the highest attainable standard of health — 달성 가능한 최고 수준의 건강. The human right to ___ ←정답
❌ ③ the treatment of sick patients — 환자 치료 (앞 문단 주어, 권리 대상 부적합)
❌ ④ the availability of public sanitation — 공중 위생 이용 가능성 (뒤에서 depends on과 연결, 빈칸 자리 아님)
det.tip: the highest attainable standard of health = 달성 가능한 최고 수준의 건강. 세계보건기구(WHO) 헌장 표현

The former was the goddess of preventive health and wellness, or hygiene, and the latter the goddess of treatment and curing. In modern times, the societal ascendancy of medical professionalism has caused treatment of sick patients to overshadow those preventive healthcare services provided by the less heroic figures of sanitary engineers, biologists, and governmental public health officers. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 건강에 대한 인간의 권리는 '공중 보건 서비스'에 의사와 병원의 기술 못지않게 달려 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① medical professionalism — 의료 전문성 (앞 문장에서 치료 우위의 원인으로 언급, 권리의 근거가 아님)
❌ ② pharmaceutical products — 의약품 (앞에서 공중 위생보다 덜 중요하다고 언급)
❌ ③ bioengineered devices — 생명공학 장치 (앞에서 공중 위생보다 덜 중요하다고 언급)
✅ ④ public healthcare services — 공중 보건 서비스. depends on ___ no less than on ... doctors ←정답
det.tip: public healthcare services = 공중 보건 서비스. 본문의 핵심 논지는 공중 보건이 의료 기술 못지않게 중요하다는 것
